name: travel-vocab-soft-filled-cyan
label: 旅行词汇浅青填充图标
preamble: Soft filled flat mobile-app icons with gently rounded geometric shapes, crisp edges, subtle two-tone color blocking, no outline, no shadow, and a calm friendly finish.

construction.grid: 24-unit keyline; live area about 75%; optical centering
construction.detail_budget: one core idea; no more than 3-4 main shapes
construction.fill_rule: front-facing rounded filled shapes with a small lighter accent
construction.color_rule: use only the locked cyan palette; keep accents lighter and smaller than the main form
construction.motif: a compact light accent that communicates sound or language
